title: Gulf Bank - Marathon
description:
Beyond the Finish Line: Gulf Bank Marathon

How do you capture an event with exactly 10,015 registrants? By being everywhere at once.

For the Gulf Bank 642 Marathon, Astroshot delivered comprehensive coverage that went far beyond the starting line.

 From stunning aerial views of the massive red-carpet coastal track to the vibrant energy of the event village. We documented every pulse-pounding moment.

title: Flex - Energy Overload
description: Astroshot produced an energetic, presenter-led commercial for Flex in Kuwait. By walking the audience through their premium cardio, spin, and strength training zones, we delivered a fast-paced, highly engaging video that perfectly matches the energy of the brand.

title: Jahez - 3-City Free Delivery Campaign
description:
For its 180 Days of Free Delivery campaign, Saudi food delivery platform Jahez needed content capable of making a major impact across social media. The campaign would span Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dhahran, with one major challenge: the entire production had to happen in less than one week.

The challenge
Producing three mixed reality CGI films normally involves multiple stages of production and post-production. For Jahez, Astroshot needed to complete the entire process, from filming through final delivery, within an exceptionally compressed timeline while maintaining the quality required for a major Saudi brand.

Three cities. Three mixed reality films.
Astroshot produced three location-specific mixed reality CGI videos across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dhahran. Each execution connected the physical city with CGI and VFX to turn Jahez's 180 Days of Free Delivery offer into social-first entertainment rather than a traditional promotional announcement.

Delivered in under one week
The project moved into priority production immediately. Within less than seven days, Astroshot completed the full pipeline: shooting, 3D modeling, VFX, compositing, color grading, sound design, and delivery.

All three films were completed and delivered within the campaign deadline.

The result: 80M+ views
The campaign generated 80M+ total views, became Jahez's most-viewed TikTok video at the time of the campaign, and delivered three mixed reality CGI films across three Saudi cities in under one week.

What began as an exceptionally tight production challenge became one of the highest-performing campaigns in Jahez's social media history.

3 cities. Under 7 days. 80M+ views.

title: Jahez - In the Sky
description:
Jahez takes to the skies with a massive balloon carrying the message of 180 days of free delivery.
This bold and eye-catching activation captures attention from afar, turning heads and sparking curiosity for the Jahez app.
A perfect blend of creativity and visibility, making a free delivery offer feel larger than life.
